The Borrower must meet two financial covenants under the Facility Agreement. First, the Borrower must ensure that its leverage (total net debt to EBITDA) does not exceed 3.0:1 on each test date [1]. Second, the Borrower must ensure that its interest cover is at least 4.0:1 on each test date [1].

A breach of clause 19 constitutes an event of default [1]. If an event of default occurs, the Lender may cancel the facility and declare all loans immediately due [1].
